summary: Fixed a stats bug that left every channel but Paisa Panchayat without the spoken line at its drop points, plus two small worker bugs; wrote the video verdicts and the first picture tally with directed Shorts, and queued a look test for the 5-8 s promise beat.
why: The data audit had no errors, but the Why Atlas' and the tech channel's drop points had empty beat and line fields: stats looked for their timelines in Paisa Panchayat's folder. The tally shows directed Shorts lose 22.2 points at the promise beat in 10 of 11.

findings.title: Other channels' drop points had no line (all channels)
findings.detail: workers/stats.ts looked up timeline.json in the default channel's folder for every channel. Fixed with a test.

findings.title: Other channels' Shorts go up without our cover (owner-only file)
findings.detail: workers/publish.ts has the same folder mistake; owner notification with the fix.

findings.title: No weekly-loop test since 19 Nov (paisa-panchayat)
findings.detail: cycle/backlog.json running is null; the improver's 20 Nov branch was blocked on a conflict and there is no improver report for 20-21 Nov.

findings.title: Directed Shorts lose most at the promise beat (paisa-panchayat)
findings.detail: 22.2 points on average at 5-8 s in 10 of 11 directed Shorts, against 14.4 for build beats; challenger promise-stays-in-hook-place added.
